result.question: What does the man of God say to the king?

readings.answer: He refuses to go with him or to eat or drink there.
readings.support: I still would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water in this place.

readings.answer: He explains that the LORD commanded him not to eat, drink, or return by the way he came.
readings.support: For this is what I was commanded by the word of the LORD: ‘You must not eat bread or drink water or return by the way you came.’

assessments.reason: This includes the keyed refusal “I will not go with you” and adds supported details about not eating or drinking, which are also in the reply.
He also says this to the king in the passage, but it is a different statement from the keyed refusal and thus answers a different facet of the open question.

result.reason: The man of God makes several distinct statements to the king, so the broad question allows multiple materially different correct answers.
